reviews.author: Heather Perry
reviews.text: Mr.McLean is only plumber that I will call. He is very knowledgeable, professional and will not take advantage of you. I recommend him to everybody!!! I have had him work on a couple issues for me and he has come through every time and tells you what's causing the problems and what he's going to do to fix it.

reviews.author: Sarah McKoy
reviews.text: Mr. McLean is a top notch plumber. I have been having problems with the water pump. He shows up when he says he will and so far has been able to fix the problems in one visit when other plumbers seem to have to go for parts come back. He also explains the problem he found and the fix or adjustment he made. I would recommend him anytime.

reviews.author: Debbie Wilson
reviews.text: Mr McLean was unable to make a house call but walked me step by step on what to do. Very polite, friendly and very helpful. He is officially my go to person. I would recommend him to everyone.
